_schema: recipe_provenance: one key per RECIPE_FLAG in scripts/launch_gate.py. The VALUE is where the number came from -- an experiments.jsonl run name, a committed probe artifact path, or a facts id. A flag whose value is UNSOURCED keeps launch-gate red. Written by e1 as an empty schema; the contents belong to fb and tilerl, because a provenance file asserting sources its author did not verify is the defect this gate exists to catch.
